summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release reporting monthly vehicle delivery results for August 2026, delivering 39,107 vehicles, up 4% year-over-year. The release also highlights the debut of the XPENG G9L, a permit for remote testing of intelligent connected vehicles in Guangzhou, and an ESG metric on emissions reduction. No special-situation corporate event is announced. This is a routine operational update on a foreign private issuer's monthly sales, not a capital markets transaction or strategic initiative.
